stackItems.backend: ASP.NET Core 8 (Clean Architecture) with Serilog, Swagger, ProblemDetails, health checks, rate limiting, CORS.
stackItems.frontend: React + Vite + TypeScript (strict), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui foundation, React Router.

stackItems.ci: GitHub Actions workflow runs build, test, and lint on every pull request.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.lead: Tokenised primitives, three age-aware themes, and full RTL support. Visual QA harness only — not a production page.

sectionLead.colors: Semantic colour tokens. Every component reads from these CSS variables — never hardcoded hex values.
sectionLead.typography: Type scale at the active theme's base font size. Inter for Latin, Cairo for Arabic.
sectionLead.radius: Radius scale. Junior is rounder, Staff is tighter, Explorer sits in the middle.
sectionLead.shadows: Three-step elevation scale, neutral and direction-agnostic.
sectionLead.motion: Hover a card to animate. Junior is slower and friendlier, Staff is snappy.
sectionLead.buttons: All variants and sizes. Focus rings are visible. Icons size automatically.
sectionLead.inputs: Form fields with labels. Focus state uses the theme's ring colour.
sectionLead.cards: Surface containers. Composed of Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter.
sectionLead.badges: Status pills. Use sparingly — never as decoration.
sectionLead.dialog: Modal dialog with focus trap. Backdrop, animation, close button mirror correctly in RTL.
sectionLead.sheet: Side panels. `side="start"` and `side="end"` resolve along the inline axis, so they auto-flip in RTL.
sectionLead.dropdown: Menu attached to a trigger. Keyboard-navigable.
sectionLead.tabs: Tab list with three panels. Arrow keys move focus.
sectionLead.tooltip: Hover or focus the button to reveal.
